shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — plus paintable glass skylight zones (stackable, grow-light sun), mountain-top rivers with waterfalls, island-aware logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection OR compile-ref. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- See-below VISION extends through glass; a pane is a WINDOW (flood-unfogs below). Orders through glass = orders through air.
- Selection survives column-internal view switches. Mountain rivers MOVE, not duplicate. **River flow data is optional — key generation on river TERRAIN, degrade visuals/direction gracefully (riverFlowMap is per-variant, riverGraph never scribed).**
- Pocket maps have no real celestial/climate data — sun/weather/temperature reads resolve through the GROUND map.
- **Underground levels use the engine's underground lighting mode: AB_Underground sets disableSkyLighting (the vanilla Biome_Underground PARENT does not carry it).**
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop + AB_Skylight (glass, dontRender).

## LIVE TEST ROUNDS 3-4 RESOLUTIONS (2026-07-24)
- **RMB CROSS-LEVEL: USER-VERIFIED WORKING.** The selection-preservation fix (Notify_SwitchedMap wipe) + ReplayFresh regeneration replay closed it. Stairs right-click + diagnostics shipped alongside.
- **BLACK BASEMENTS: ROOT-CAUSED + FIXED, skylights exonerated (user had asked to remove the feature).** Chain: AB_Underground inherited Biome_Underground WITHOUT disableSkyLighting -> standard sky lighting on a thick-roofed map -> the per-section lighting overlay (regenerating ONLY on glow/roof dirt) rendered pitch black wherever it regenerated -> the skylight shafts' first glow update triggered the regen and took the blame ("skylights cause basements to render black"; any lamp would have too). Evidence: light diagnostic glow=1.00 with black screen = data lit, render dark. FIX: disableSkyLighting on AB_Underground — SkyManager zeroes the LightOverlay darkness channel; unlit basement renders dim-neutral, lamp + shaft pools show like vanilla underground maps. Skylight feature KEPT.
- **RIVERS: silent no-op root-caused via diagnostic** ("ran, bailed: no flow data"): this quicktest map's river variant has an EMPTY riverFlowMap (1.6 per-variant; riverGraph never scribed) and the old hard bail skipped everything — the "duplicate" was the see-below view. FIX BUILT (flow-optional carve/dry/banks; no-flow lips all pour) — **AWAITS RELAUNCH + fresh column; user's latest "still on both maps" observation predates the fix by session.**
- Shaft sun gate reads the ground map (pocket celestial fix). Waterfall [StaticConstructorOnStartup]. River diagnostic hardened (resolves column from any level).

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE (warnings cross the bridge)
AB: RMB diagnostic (ToolMap) · AB: river diagnostic (incl. genstep LastSummary + bail reasons + live wet-under-mass count) · AB: light diagnostic (ToolMap: glow/roof/fog, sun ground-vs-this, glowers lit+power, shaft chain, paneAbove) · AB: below-view diagnostic · AB: ensure sky + basement.

## OPEN VERIFICATION QUEUE (relaunch round 5)
1. Basement renders dim-neutral w/ working lamp pools (disableSkyLighting) — with and without skylights.
2. Panes light the room below in daytime (shaft chain: needs an under-pane light-diagnostic click if visuals disputed).
3. Rivers on a fresh column: carve/dry/banks even without flow data; wet-under-mass=0 in the river diagnostic.
4. Below lighting from above (lamp pools through the gap), selection persistence re-check, stairs RMB option.
Then the standing stack: animal flow, direct-to-blueprint, BAM (companion), Batch B/C, perf-mod smoke, translation audit, soak, publishing.

## FEATURE LEDGER (unchanged from prior passes)
RMB 1:1 parity batch (VERIFIED) · direct-to-blueprint hauling · below-level lighting (belowLighting setting) · animal flow fix (scribed pet returns, wild hard-overdue) · BAM compat · perf pass + perf-mod audit (PO/TPT decompiled, invariants documented) · Batch D skylights (fog reveal, ground-map sun) + mountain rivers (superseding rework, flow-optional) · Batch A verified · Batch B/C built pending · logistics/areas/combat/settings as documented in pass 9-13.

## Compat
(unchanged) + Better Architect Menu. Perf mods audited. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (14th pass): **RMB verified by user; black-basement mechanism found (missing disableSkyLighting) and fixed in one line — skylights kept; river flow-optional fix awaiting fresh-column verification.** Relaunch round 5 pending.
